Title: Verify that a user who fails the CMS check can retrigger the CMS step and advance to KYC Status 1 after their CMS record is corrected
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- Non-JM market account (KY, VG, GY, or TT) — fresh, not yet KYC-verified
- Test identity available in Ondato sandbox that will pass identity verification
- CMS configured: user initially fails (e.g. name mismatch), then record corrected to pass before step 6
- Ability to verify KYC status in the test environment

Step Action: Launch the eKYC flow and complete Ondato with a passing test identity
Confirm the CMS check triggers automatically — no user action required
Step Expected: CMS check is triggered immediately after positive Ondato response

Step Action: Confirm the CMS check fails; confirm the user is set to KYC Status 8
Step Expected: User is at KYC Status 8; flow stops

Step Action: Confirm the Home screen displays the failure state
Step Expected: Home screen shows the "We couldn't confirm your identity." banner with the "Visit Retail Location" CTA

Step Action: Tap the CTA — confirm the Documents Required screen opens
Step Expected: Documents Required screen is shown with the document list and both "Find a retail location" and "Retry ID Verification" options visible

Step Action: In the CMS test environment, correct the user's record so it will now pass
Tap "Retry ID Verification"
Step Expected: The "Action Needed" modal appears with the tenant-configured wording and "No, go back" / "Yes, I have" options

Step Action: Tap "Yes, I have"
Confirm Ondato is NOT re-triggered during the retry
Step Expected: No Ondato SDK session is opened; no Ondato webhook fires

Step Action: Confirm the CMS check passes and the user is set to KYC Status 1
Step Expected: KYC Status 8 → 1; user proceeds into the remainder of the eKYC flow (eKYC completion screen)

Title: Verify that tapping "No, go back" on the Action Needed modal dismisses the modal without retriggering the CMS check
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- Non-JM market account at KYC Status 8 (CMS check previously failed)
- User is on the Documents Required screen

Step Action: Tap "Retry ID Verification"
Step Expected: The "Action Needed" modal appears

Step Action: Tap "No, go back"
Step Expected: Modal is dismissed; user is returned to the Documents Required screen

Step Action: Confirm KYC Status remains 8 and no CMS check was triggered
Step Expected: KYC Status unchanged; no CMS call made

Title: Verify that a CMS retry that fails again leaves the user at KYC Status 8 with the retry option still available
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- Non-JM market account at KYC Status 8
- CMS record has NOT been corrected (will still fail on retry)

Step Action: Navigate to the Documents Required screen via the Home screen banner
Tap "Retry ID Verification" → confirm modal appears → tap "Yes, I have"
Confirm the CMS check runs and fails again
Confirm the user remains at KYC Status 8
Step Expected: KYC Status unchanged at 8

Step Action: Confirm the Home screen banner is still shown and the Documents Required screen is still accessible with "Retry ID Verification" available
Step Expected: Retry option is not removed; user is not locked out

Title: Verify that the CMS retry does not re-trigger the Ondato identity verification flow
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- Non-JM market account at KYC Status 8
- CMS configured to pass on retry
- Ability to observe whether Ondato SDK is launched (network log, Ondato sandbox event log, or webhook log)

Step Action: Navigate to Documents Required screen → tap "Retry ID Verification" → tap "Yes, I have"
Monitor for any Ondato SDK session being opened or any Ondato webhook activity during the retry
Step Expected: No Ondato SDK session is opened; no new Ondato webhook is received

Step Action: Allow the CMS check to complete
Step Expected: Only the CMS lookup executes; KYC Status advances to 1 without Ondato being involved

Title: Verify that the Action Needed modal wording reflects the correct resolution path for the tenant (retail location vs CSC)
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:

- Two test accounts in markets with different configured resolution paths (one retail-location market, one CSC market)
- Each account at KYC Status 8

Step Action: On the retail-location market account: navigate to Documents Required → tap "Retry ID Verification"; note the Action Needed modal wording
On the CSC market account: repeat the same steps; note the Action Needed modal wording
Compare the two modal messages
Step Expected: Modal wording differs between markets per tenant configuration; neither market shows the other's wording; both modals show "No, go back" and "Yes, I have" regardless of wording variant

Title: Verify that the employment details screen is not shown when the selected employment status does not require it
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- Non-JM market account that has passed Ondato and CMS check
- User is on the employment status screen in the eKYC completion flow

Step Action: On the employment status screen, select Unemployed
Tap Continue
Step Expected: The employment details screen (Employer/School Name, address, industry, etc.) is not shown; user proceeds directly to the next step of the eKYC flow

Step Action: Return to the employment status screen and select Retired
Tap Continue
Step Expected: The employment details screen is not shown; user proceeds directly to the next step of the eKYC flow

Step Action: Confirm that selecting Employed, Self-Employed, or Student does show the employment details screen (sanity check)
Step Expected: Employment details screen appears only for Employed, Self-Employed, and Student; Unemployed and Retired bypass it
